WITH RAW_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(
            CAST(
                @{item().partition_column}
                AS VARCHAR(100)
            )
        ) AS RAW_VAL
    FROM
        @{if(
            empty(trim(coalesce(item().cdc_tgt_schema_nm, ''))),
            item().src_schema_nm,
            item().cdc_tgt_schema_nm
        )}.@{item().src_table_nm}
),

DISTINCT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE

            /* 1. STRING + MONTHLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'monthly'
            THEN RAW_VAL

            /* 2. STRING + YEARLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'yearly'
            THEN LEFT(RAW_VAL, 4)

            /* 3. DATE/TIMESTAMP + MONTHLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}'))
                    IN ('date', 'timestamp')
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'monthly'
            THEN REPLACE(
                    LEFT(RAW_VAL, 7),
                    '-',
                    ''
                 )

            /* 4. DATE/TIMESTAMP + YEARLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}'))
                    IN ('date', 'timestamp')
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'yearly'
            THEN LEFT(RAW_VAL, 4)

            ELSE NULL
        END AS PARTITION_VAL,

        CASE

            /* STRING + MONTHLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'monthly'
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NOT NULL
                     AND REGEXP_LIKE(
                            RAW_VAL,
                            '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
                         )
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            /* STRING + YEARLY */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}')) = 'string'
             AND LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')) = 'yearly'
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NOT NULL
                     AND
                     (
                         REGEXP_LIKE(
                             RAW_VAL,
                             '^[0-9]{4}$'
                         )

                         OR

                         REGEXP_LIKE(
                             RAW_VAL,
                             '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
                         )
                     )
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END

            /* DATE / TIMESTAMP */
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_data_type, '')}'))
                    IN ('date', 'timestamp')
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NULL
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END

            ELSE 0
        END AS VALID_YN

    FROM RAW_PARTITION
),

VALID_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        PARTITION_VAL
    FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
    WHERE VALID_YN = 1

      AND
      (
          TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_from, '')}') = ''

          OR

          PARTITION_VAL >=
              CASE
                  WHEN LOWER(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')
                       ) = 'yearly'
                  THEN LEFT(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_from, '')}'),
                           4
                       )
                  ELSE
                       TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_from, '')}')
              END
      )

      AND
      (
          TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_to, '')}') = ''

          OR

          PARTITION_VAL <=
              CASE
                  WHEN LOWER(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_range, '')}')
                       ) = 'yearly'
                  THEN LEFT(
                           TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_to, '')}'),
                           4
                       )
                  ELSE
                       TRIM('@{coalesce(item().partition_to, '')}')
              END
      )
),

RESULT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        PARTITION_VAL AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM VALID_PARTITION

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'INVALID' AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
    WHERE EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
        WHERE VALID_YN = 0
    )
)

SELECT
    LISTAGG(
        '"' || PARTITION_ID || '"',
        ','
    )
    WITHIN GROUP
    (
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN PARTITION_ID = 'INVALID'
                THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END,
            PARTITION_ID
    ) AS PARTITION_LIST
FROM RESULT_PARTITION
WITH UR

INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master
(
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    src_type,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
    partition_clause,
    exec_group,
    condition_type,
    condition_frequency,
    condition_interval,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_column_type,
    incr_column_hw_val,
    last_success_dt,
    delete_yn,
    init_wait_yn,
    created_by,
    created_dt,
    update_by,
    update_dt
)
SELECT
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    src_type,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
    partition_clause,
    exec_group,
    condition_type,
    condition_frequency,
    condition_interval,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_column_type,
    incr_column_hw_val,

    NULL                        AS last_success_dt,
    'N'                         AS delete_yn,
    init_wait_yn,
    created_by,
    created_dt,
    NULL                        AS update_by,
    NULL                        AS update_dt

FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master_staging
WHERE pipeline_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}';

WITH target_src AS
(
      SELECT
        m.*,
        NULLIF(m.partition_clause, '')::jsonb AS partition_json
    FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master m
    WHERE  m.init_wait_yn = 'Y'
      AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
      AND m.data_class = 'RAW'
      AND m.exec_group = '@{variables('pv_exec_group')}'
),

partition_src AS
(
    SELECT
        m.*,

        m.partition_json ->> 'partition_column'
            AS partition_column,

        UPPER(m.partition_json ->> 'partition_range')
            AS partition_range,

        UPPER(m.partition_json ->> 'data_type')
            AS partition_data_type,

        p.partition_val

    FROM target_src m

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL
    (
        SELECT x AS partition_val
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
            m.partition_json -> 'partition_val'
        ) AS j(x)
    ) p
        ON TRUE
),

query_src AS
(
    SELECT
        m.*,

        /*
         * 파티션 WHERE 조건 생성
         */
        CASE

            /* 파티션 미사용 */
            WHEN m.partition_json IS NULL
              OR m.partition_val IS NULL
            THEN ''

            /*
             * INVALID
             * STRING + MONTHLY/YEARLY(clym YYYYMM 기준)
             */
            WHEN m.partition_val = 'INVALID'
             AND m.partition_data_type = 'STRING'
            THEN
                ' WHERE ('
                || m.partition_column
                || ' IS NULL'
                || ' OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE('
                || m.partition_column
                || ', ''^[0-9]{6}$'')'
                || ' OR SUBSTR('
                || m.partition_column
                || ', 5, 2) NOT BETWEEN ''01'' AND ''12'''
                || ')'

            /*
             * DATE / TIMESTAMP INVALID
             * 타입 컬럼이므로 비정상 문자열은 존재할 수 없고
             * NULL만 INVALID 처리
             */
            WHEN m.partition_val = 'INVALID'
             AND m.partition_data_type IN ('DATE', 'TIMESTAMP')
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' IS NULL'

            /*
             * STRING + MONTHLY
             * ex) clym = '202601'
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'STRING'
             AND m.partition_range = 'MONTHLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' = '''
                || m.partition_val
                || ''''

            /*
             * STRING + YEARLY
             * clym 컬럼은 YYYYMM 형태
             *
             * 2026
             * => 202601 <= clym < 202701
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'STRING'
             AND m.partition_range = 'YEARLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= '''
                || m.partition_val
                || '01'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < '''
                || ((m.partition_val::int + 1)::text)
                || '01'''

            /*
             * DATE + MONTHLY
             *
             * 202601
             * => 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-02-01
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'DATE'
             AND m.partition_range = 'MONTHLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'),
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ''''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                       + INTERVAL '1 month',
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ''''

            /*
             * DATE + YEARLY
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'DATE'
             AND m.partition_range = 'YEARLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= '''
                || m.partition_val
                || '-01-01'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < '''
                || ((m.partition_val::int + 1)::text)
                || '-01-01'''

            /*
             * TIMESTAMP + MONTHLY
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
             AND m.partition_range = 'MONTHLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= TIMESTAMP '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'),
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ' 00:00:00'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < TIMESTAMP '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                       + INTERVAL '1 month',
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ' 00:00:00'''

            /*
             * TIMESTAMP + YEARLY
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
             AND m.partition_range = 'YEARLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= TIMESTAMP '''
                || m.partition_val
                || '-01-01 00:00:00'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < TIMESTAMP '''
                || ((m.partition_val::int + 1)::text)
                || '-01-01 00:00:00'''

            ELSE ''

        END AS partition_where

    FROM partition_src m
),

-- ============================================================================
-- FULL 전용 수집 스크립트 : pl_raw_orch_full > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
--   흐름 : Script -> Filter Not Skipped -> ForEach Child Ingest -> pl_dispatcher_ingest (파라미터 6개 그대로)
--
--   대상   : Run Group(p_run_group_nm) 중 실행유형 FULL (그룹 job_type_cd = RAW_FULL / META_FULL)
--            p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능 (예: [1001,1002])
--            삭제 · 초기적재 대기 · 비활성 그룹/규칙 Target 은 vw_ingest_exec_target 에서 제외됨
--   파티션 : 사용 안 함 (Target 당 1행). FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH 는 별도 스크립트
--   적재방식 : GEN2 = FULL_DELETE_INSERT, TABLE Sink = NULL
--
--   CDC 규칙
--     추출 위치 (쿼리 스키마, 자식 파이프라인 DB) = COALESCE(NULLIF(cdc_tgt_*, ''), src_*)
--     GEN2 파일명                               = src_* (CDC 소스)
--     ※ CDC 타겟 테이블명은 소스와 같다고 전제
--
--   GEN2 경로 · 파일명 (Target 별)
--     master 값이 있으면 그 값 사용 (토큰 치환), 없으면(NULL / 공백) 스크립트가 조립
--     landing_path
--       있음 : 토큰 치환 {batch_date} {batch_hour} {pipeline_nm}
--       없음 : {data_class 소문자}/batch_date=YYYYMMDD/batch_hour=HH/pipeline_name={자식 파이프라인명}
--     file_nm_template
--       있음 : 토큰 치환 {src_db} {schema} {table} {part}(FULL 은 '') {ts}
--       없음 : {src_db}.{src_schema}.{src_table}.{YYYYMMDDHHMISS}.parquet
--
--   선행 조건
--     - ctl_ingest_target_master / ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 에 cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm 컬럼
--       (adf_meta_alter_v83_cdc_tgt.sql)
--     - ctl_master_pipeline_run 에 이번 RunId 행 (FK)
--
--   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용
-- ============================================================================
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                  AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text               AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb    AS target_ids,
           '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text                     AS batch_str,
           '@{if(pipeline().globalParameters.gp_pipeline_run_skip, 'Y', 'N')}'::text AS skip_yn,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                             AS created_by
),
-- ① 대상 + 추출 위치
t0 AS (
    SELECT e.run_group_id, e.run_rule_id, m.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(m.landing_path), '')     AS landing_path_in,
           NULLIF(trim(m.file_nm_template), '') AS file_nm_template_in
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target    e ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = e.target_id
     WHERE e.run_type_cd = 'FULL'
       AND (p.target_ids IS NULL
            OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.target_ids)::bigint))
),
-- ② 자식 파이프라인명 · 경로 · 파일명
t AS (
    SELECT t0.*, x.pl_nm,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(t0.landing_path_in,
                        '{batch_date}',  left(p.batch_str, 8)),
                        '{batch_hour}',  substr(p.batch_str, 9, 2)),
                        '{pipeline_nm}', x.pl_nm)
                ELSE lower(t0.data_class)
                     || '/batch_date='    || left(p.batch_str, 8)
                     || '/batch_hour='    || substr(p.batch_str, 9, 2)
                     || '/pipeline_name=' || x.pl_nm
           END AS landing_path_out,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(t0.file_nm_template_in,
                        '{src_db}', t0.src_db_nm), '{schema}', t0.src_schema_nm), '{table}', t0.src_table_nm),
                        '{part}', ''), '{ts}', p.batch_str)
                ELSE t0.src_db_nm || '.' || t0.src_schema_nm || '.' || t0.src_table_nm
                     || '.' || p.batch_str || '.parquet'
           END AS file_name_out
      FROM t0 CROSS JOIN p
      -- 자식 파이프라인명 : pl_{data_class}_ingest_{src_type}_{추출 DB}  예) pl_raw_ingest_db2_MLCRP
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 'pl_' || lower(t0.data_class) || '_ingest_' || lower(t0.src_type)
                                 || '_' || upper(t0.ext_db_nm) AS pl_nm) x
),
-- ③ 수집 이력 PENDING / SKIPPED 생성
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, run_group_id, run_rule_id, target_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, run_type_cd,
           sink_type_cd, load_method_cd,
           src_type, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, data_class,
           extract_query, landing_path, file_name, sink_table_full_nm, status, created_by)
    SELECT p.master_run_id, t.run_group_id, t.run_rule_id, t.target_id, t.pl_nm, 'FULL',
           t.sink_type_cd,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' THEN 'FULL_DELETE_INSERT' END,
           t.src_type, t.src_db_nm, t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''), NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), t.data_class,
           -- 추출쿼리 : 템플릿 우선({WHERE} -> 1=1), 없으면 SELECT * (추출 위치 스키마)
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t.src_query_template), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(t.src_query_template, '{WHERE}', '1=1')
                ELSE 'SELECT * FROM ' || t.ext_schema_nm || '.' || t.src_table_nm
                     || CASE upper(t.src_type) WHEN 'DB2'   THEN ' WITH UR'
                                               WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                                               ELSE '' END
           END,
           t.landing_path_out,
           t.file_name_out,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'TABLE' THEN concat_ws('.', t.sink_db_nm, t.sink_schema_nm, t.sink_table_nm) END,
           CASE p.skip_yn WHEN 'Y' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,
           p.created_by
      FROM t CROSS JOIN p
    RETURNING ingest_pipeline_id, master_run_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, extract_query, landing_path, file_name,
              sink_table_full_nm, target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm,
              cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, status
)
-- ④ ForEach 입력. Filter Not Skipped : @not(equals(item().status, 'SKIPPED'))
SELECT ingest_pipeline_id,                                  -- p_ingest_pipeline_id
       master_run_id,                                       -- p_master_run_id
       ingest_pipeline_nm,                                  -- p_child_pipeline_nm
       extract_query,                                       -- p_extract_query
       COALESCE(landing_path, '')       AS landing_path,    -- p_landing_path (TABLE Sink 는 '')
       COALESCE(file_name, '')          AS file_name,       -- p_file_name    (TABLE Sink 는 '')
       COALESCE(sink_table_full_nm, '') AS sink_table_full_nm,
       target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
       sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, status
  FROM ins
 ORDER BY src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm;

-- ============================================================================
-- pl_raw_orch_full > Script "Ins_master_run" (FULL 수집 첫 활동)
--   ctl_master_pipeline_run 에 이번 실행을 PENDING 으로 등록
--     -> Start_ingest_pipeline Script (수집 이력 생성 + Master RUNNING 전환)
--     -> ForEach -> 종료 Script (SUCCEEDED / FAILED)
--
--   진입 구분 : 그룹에 스케줄이 있고 수동 실행(Manual)이 아니면 SCHEDULE, 그 외 MANUAL
--   그룹명이 틀리거나 비활성이면 행이 만들어지지 않고 에러 (아래 검증)
--   같은 RunId 재실행 시 무시 (ON CONFLICT)
--   선행 : ck_master_status 에 PENDING 추가 (adf_meta_alter_v83_cdc_tgt.sql)
-- ============================================================================
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                  AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'::text                                AS pipeline_nm,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text               AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb    AS target_ids,
           '@{pipeline().TriggerType}'::text                             AS trigger_type,   -- Manual / ScheduleTrigger / PipelineActivity ...
           '@{pipeline().TriggerName}'::text                             AS trigger_nm,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                             AS created_by
),
g AS (
    SELECT p.*, g.run_group_id, g.schedule_id,
           (g.schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND p.trigger_type <> 'Manual') AS sch_yn
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
        ON g.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
       AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
       AND g.job_type_cd IN ('RAW_FULL', 'META_FULL')      -- FULL 전용 마스터
),
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, master_pipeline_nm, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, schedule_id, run_group_id,
           run_param, status, created_by)
    SELECT g.master_run_id, g.pipeline_nm,
           CASE WHEN g.sch_yn THEN 'SCHEDULE' ELSE 'MANUAL' END,
           NULLIF(g.trigger_nm, ''),
           CASE WHEN g.sch_yn THEN g.schedule_id END,
           g.run_group_id,
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('target_ids', g.target_ids)),
           'PENDING',
           g.created_by
      FROM g
    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING master_run_id, trigger_type_cd, schedule_id, run_group_id, status
)
SELECT i.master_run_id, i.trigger_type_cd, i.schedule_id, i.run_group_id, i.status,
       -- 그룹명 오류 · 비활성 · FULL 그룹 아님 -> 형변환 오류로 활동 실패 (메시지에 그룹명 표시)
       CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM g) = 0
            THEN ('RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_FULL:' || (SELECT run_group_nm FROM p))::int
            ELSE 1 END AS chk
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN ins i ON TRUE;

-- ============================================================================
-- INCR 전용 수집 스크립트 : pl_raw_orch_incr > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
--   흐름 : Ins_master_run(PENDING) -> Set Variable(pv_incr_from_val) -> 이 Script
--          -> Filter Not Skipped -> ForEach -> pl_dispatcher_ingest
--          실패 시 Fail_master_run, ForEach 완료 시 End_master_run (adf_script_v83_master_end.sql)
--
--   대상   : Run Group(p_run_group_nm, job_type_cd = RAW_INCR) 의 INCR 대상 (vw_ingest_exec_target)
--            p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능 (예: [1001,1002])
--   증분 조건 : 증분컬럼 >= 시작일  (시작일 = pv_incr_from_val, 모든 대상 공통)
--     pv_incr_from_val : ADF Set Variable. 파라미터 p_incr_from_val 이 있으면 그 값, 없으면 오늘 - N 일
--                        형식 yyyy-MM-dd 또는 yyyyMMdd
--     증분컬럼 유형 (master.incr_column_type) · 형식 (master.incr_column_format)
--       DATE      DB2 : col >= DATE('2026-10-01')             MSSQL : CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)
--                 기타 : col >= DATE '2026-10-01'
--       TIMESTAMP DB2 : col >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01 00:00:00') MSSQL : CAST('2026-10-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME2)
--                 기타 : col >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
--       STRING  + 형식 : col >= '20261001'  (시작일을 형식대로 변환. YYYYMMDD / YYYY-MM-DD / YYYYMM ...)
--       NUMERIC + 형식 : col >= 20261001    (숫자형 날짜. 따옴표 없음)
--       형식은 PostgreSQL to_char 형식 (YYYY MM DD HH24 MI SS)
--     상한 · HWM 사용 안 함 (incr_to_val = NULL)
--
--   DBX 전달 (GEN2)
--     load_method_cd = master.incr_load_method_cd (UPSERT / RANGE_DELETE_INSERT ...)
--     RANGE_DELETE_INSERT : range_column_nm = 증분컬럼, range_operator_cd = '>=',
--                           range_value = ["YYYYMMDD"] (월 형식 컬럼은 ["YYYYMM"])
--
--   CDC / 경로 / 파일명 : FULL 스크립트와 동일
--     추출 위치 = COALESCE(NULLIF(cdc_tgt_*, ''), src_*), 파일명 = src_*
--     landing_path 없으면 incr/batch_date=YYYYMMDD/batch_hour=HH/pipeline_name={자식 파이프라인명}
--     file_nm_template 없으면 {src_db}.{src_schema}.{src_table}.{YYYYMMDDHHMISS}.parquet
--
--   즉시 실패 (형변환 오류로 Script 실패 -> 실패 경로에서 Master FAILED)
--     시작일 없음 / 형식 오류          -> INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:값
--     STRING / NUMERIC 인데 형식 없음  -> INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:target_id
--     그 외 유형                       -> INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:target_id
--
--   Script 재시도 = 0. ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용
-- ============================================================================
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text                     AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb          AS target_ids,
           trim('@{variables('pv_incr_from_val')}')                            AS from_in,     -- yyyy-MM-dd / yyyyMMdd
           '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text                           AS batch_str,
           '@{if(pipeline().globalParameters.gp_pipeline_run_skip, 'Y', 'N')}'::text AS skip_yn,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                   AS created_by
),
-- ⓪ 시작일 검증 · 변환
d AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           CASE WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN to_date(p.from_in, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{8}$'                  THEN to_date(p.from_in, 'YYYYMMDD')
                ELSE to_date(('INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:' || p.from_in)::int::text, 'YYYY')
           END AS from_dt
      FROM p
),
-- ① 대상 + 추출 위치
t0 AS (
    SELECT e.run_group_id, e.run_rule_id, m.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(m.landing_path), '')     AS landing_path_in,
           NULLIF(trim(m.file_nm_template), '') AS file_nm_template_in
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target    e ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm AND e.run_type_cd = 'INCR'
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = e.target_id
     WHERE p.target_ids IS NULL
        OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.target_ids)::bigint)
),
-- ② 조건 · 자식 파이프라인명 · 경로 · 파일명
t AS (
    SELECT t0.*, x.pl_nm,
           -- 기록용 시작값 : 증분컬럼 형식 (DATE / TIMESTAMP 는 YYYY-MM-DD)
           CASE WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) IN ('STRING','NUMERIC') AND NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format)
                ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS from_val,
           -- DBX 범위 값 : 월 형식(일 없음) 컬럼은 YYYYMM, 그 외 YYYYMMDD
           CASE WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) IN ('STRING','NUMERIC') AND t0.incr_column_format NOT ILIKE '%DD%'
                THEN to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYYMM') ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS range_val,
           t0.incr_column_nm || ' >= ' ||
           CASE upper(t0.incr_column_type)
             WHEN 'DATE' THEN
                  CASE upper(t0.src_type)
                    WHEN 'DB2'   THEN 'DATE('''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ''')'
                    WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN 'CAST('''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ''' AS DATE)'
                    ELSE              'DATE '''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '''' END
             WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN
                  CASE upper(t0.src_type)
                    WHEN 'DB2'   THEN 'TIMESTAMP(''' || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00'')'
                    WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN 'CAST('''      || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00'' AS DATETIME2)'
                    ELSE              'TIMESTAMP ''' || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00''' END
             -- 문자 · 숫자형 날짜 : 형식대로 변환
             WHEN 'STRING' THEN
                  CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NULL
                       THEN ('INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
                       ELSE '''' || to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format) || '''' END
             WHEN 'NUMERIC' THEN
                  CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NULL
                       THEN ('INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
                       ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format) END
             -- 그 외 유형 -> 형변환 오류로 Script 실패
             ELSE ('INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
           END AS cond_sql,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(t0.landing_path_in,
                        '{batch_date}',  left(d.batch_str, 8)),
                        '{batch_hour}',  substr(d.batch_str, 9, 2)),
                        '{pipeline_nm}', x.pl_nm)
                ELSE 'incr'
                     || '/batch_date='    || left(d.batch_str, 8)
                     || '/batch_hour='    || substr(d.batch_str, 9, 2)
                     || '/pipeline_name=' || x.pl_nm
           END AS landing_path_out,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(t0.file_nm_template_in,
                        '{src_db}', t0.src_db_nm), '{schema}', t0.src_schema_nm), '{table}', t0.src_table_nm),
                        '{part}', ''), '{ts}', d.batch_str)
                ELSE t0.src_db_nm || '.' || t0.src_schema_nm || '.' || t0.src_table_nm
                     || '.' || d.batch_str || '.parquet'
           END AS file_name_out
      FROM t0 CROSS JOIN d
      -- 자식 파이프라인명 : pl_{data_class}_ingest_{src_type}_{추출 DB}  예) pl_raw_ingest_db2_MLCRP
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 'pl_' || lower(t0.data_class) || '_ingest_' || lower(t0.src_type)
                                 || '_' || upper(t0.ext_db_nm) AS pl_nm) x
),
-- ③ Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING (+ 대상 건수)
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
       SET status = 'RUNNING', start_dt = now(), update_dt = now(),
           child_total_cnt = (SELECT count(*) FROM t)
      FROM p
     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'
    RETURNING m.master_run_id
),
-- ④ 수집 이력 PENDING / SKIPPED 생성
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, run_group_id, run_rule_id, target_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, run_type_cd,
           sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, range_column_nm, range_operator_cd, range_value,
           incr_policy_id, incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, incr_to_val,
           src_type, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, data_class,
           extract_query, landing_path, file_name, sink_table_full_nm, status, created_by)
    SELECT p.master_run_id, t.run_group_id, t.run_rule_id, t.target_id, t.pl_nm, 'INCR',
           t.sink_type_cd,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' THEN t.incr_load_method_cd END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT' THEN t.incr_column_nm END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT' THEN '>=' END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(t.range_val) END,
           t.incr_policy_id, t.incr_column_nm, t.from_val, NULL,
           t.src_type, t.src_db_nm, t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''), NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), t.data_class,
           -- 추출쿼리 : 템플릿 우선({WHERE} -> 증분 조건), 없으면 SELECT * (추출 위치 스키마)
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t.src_query_template), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(t.src_query_template, '{WHERE}', t.cond_sql)
                ELSE 'SELECT * FROM ' || t.ext_schema_nm || '.' || t.src_table_nm
                     || CASE WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)' ELSE '' END
                     || ' WHERE ' || t.cond_sql
                     || CASE WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'   THEN ' WITH UR'       ELSE '' END
           END,
           t.landing_path_out,
           t.file_name_out,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'TABLE' THEN concat_ws('.', t.sink_db_nm, t.sink_schema_nm, t.sink_table_nm) END,
           CASE p.skip_yn WHEN 'Y' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,
           p.created_by
      FROM t CROSS JOIN p
    RETURNING ingest_pipeline_id, master_run_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, extract_query, landing_path, file_name,
              sink_table_full_nm, target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm,
              cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, sink_type_cd, load_method_cd,
              incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, range_value, status
)
-- ⑤ ForEach 입력. Filter Not Skipped : @not(equals(item().status, 'SKIPPED'))
SELECT ingest_pipeline_id,                                  -- p_ingest_pipeline_id
       master_run_id,                                       -- p_master_run_id
       ingest_pipeline_nm,                                  -- p_child_pipeline_nm
       extract_query,                                       -- p_extract_query
       COALESCE(landing_path, '')       AS landing_path,    -- p_landing_path (TABLE Sink 는 '')
       COALESCE(file_name, '')          AS file_name,       -- p_file_name    (TABLE Sink 는 '')
       COALESCE(sink_table_full_nm, '') AS sink_table_full_nm,
       target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
       sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, range_value::text AS range_value, status
  FROM ins
 ORDER BY target_id;

value.value:
@if(

--   선행 : ck_master_status 에 PENDING 추가 (adf_meta_alter_v83_cdc_tgt.sql)

WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                  AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'::text                                AS pipeline_nm,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text               AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb    AS target_ids,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_incr_from_val}'), '')  AS incr_from_val,
           '@{pipeline().TriggerType}'::text                             AS trigger_type,   -- Manual / ScheduleTrigger / PipelineActivity ...
           '@{pipeline().TriggerName}'::text                             AS trigger_nm,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                             AS created_by
),
g AS (
    SELECT p.*, g.run_group_id, g.schedule_id,
           (g.schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND p.trigger_type <> 'Manual') AS sch_yn
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
        ON g.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
       AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
       AND g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_INCR'                       -- INCR 전용 마스터
),
ins AS (

          (master_run_id, master_pipeline_nm, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, schedule_id, run_group_id,
           run_param, status, created_by)
    SELECT g.master_run_id, g.pipeline_nm,

           NULLIF(g.trigger_nm, ''),

           g.run_group_id,
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('target_ids',    g.target_ids,
                                                'incr_from_val', g.incr_from_val)),
           'PENDING',
           g.created_by
      FROM g
    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING master_run_id, trigger_type_cd, schedule_id, run_group_id, run_param, status
)
SELECT i.master_run_id, i.trigger_type_cd, i.schedule_id, i.run_group_id, i.run_param::text AS run_param, i.status,

/* pl_cmn_master_start > Script "Ins_master_run" (v8.3)
   마스터 첫 활동. ctl_master_pipeline_run PENDING 등록 + 시작 조건 검증 (child_total_cnt = 0)
   검증 실패 : 형변환 오류로 활동 실패 (문장 전체 취소, Master 행 생성 안 됨)
   같은 master_run_id 재호출 시 무시 (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) : 자동 Retry / Rerun from failed activity 대비
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'), '')                 AS master_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_pipeline_nm}'), '')            AS pipeline_nm,
           trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_type}')                             AS trigger_type,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}'), ''), 'Manual') AS trigger_nm,
           string_to_array(upper(replace('@{pipeline().parameters.p_job_types}', ' ', '')), ',') AS job_types,
           trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}')                             AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_scheduled_time}'), '')::timestamptz  AS scheduled_dt,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'), '')::jsonb            AS target_ids,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_incr_from_val}'), '')                AS incr_from_val,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_bizday_n}'), '')                     AS bizday_n,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_bizday_offset}'), '')                AS bizday_offset,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_dbx_last_run_yn}'), '')              AS dbx_last_run_yn,
           NULLIF(upper(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_cond_unit}')), '')             AS cond_unit,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_cond_interval}'), '')                AS cond_interval,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_entry_run_id}'), '')                 AS entry_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                          AS created_by
),
/* 그룹 : 활성 + 이 마스터가 받는 작업유형 */
g AS (
    SELECT p.*, g.run_group_id, g.job_type_cd
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
        ON g.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
       AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
       AND g.job_type_cd = ANY (p.job_types)
),
/* 수동 지정 target_id 목록 */
req AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT x::bigint AS target_id
      FROM p, jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p.target_ids, '[]'::jsonb)) x
),
/* 이번 실행 수집 대상 (검증용, 건수는 기록하지 않음) */
tgt AS (
    SELECT e.target_id, e.range_unit_cd, e.range_interval
      FROM g
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e ON e.run_group_id = g.run_group_id
     WHERE g.target_ids IS NULL
        OR e.target_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM req)
),
/* 검증 1 : 지정했지만 그룹 대상이 아닌 target_id */
nf AS (
    SELECT string_agg(r.target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY r.target_id) AS ids
      FROM req r
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tgt t WHERE t.target_id = r.target_id)
),
/* 검증 2 : INCR 그룹 대상 중 증분정책(단위, N)이 마스터 설정과 다른 대상 */
mm AS (
    SELECT string_agg(t.target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY t.target_id) AS ids
      FROM tgt t, g
     WHERE g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_INCR'
       AND (   t.range_unit_cd IS DISTINCT FROM g.cond_unit
            OR t.range_interval::text IS DISTINCT FROM g.cond_interval)
),
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, master_pipeline_nm, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, scheduled_dt, run_group_id,
           run_param, entry_run_id, child_total_cnt, status, created_by)
    SELECT g.master_run_id, g.pipeline_nm,
           CASE WHEN g.trigger_type = 'Manual' THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE 'SCHEDULE' END,
           g.trigger_nm,
           g.scheduled_dt,
           g.run_group_id,
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
               'target_ids',      g.target_ids,
               'incr_from_val',   g.incr_from_val,
               'bizday_n',        g.bizday_n,
               'bizday_offset',   g.bizday_offset,
               'dbx_last_run_yn', g.dbx_last_run_yn,
               'condition',       CASE WHEN g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_INCR' THEN g.cond_unit || '/' || g.cond_interval END)),
           g.entry_run_id,
           0,
           'PENDING',
           g.created_by
      FROM g
     WHERE g.master_run_id IS NOT NULL
       AND g.pipeline_nm IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING master_run_id, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, run_group_id, run_param, child_total_cnt, status
)
SELECT i.master_run_id, i.trigger_type_cd, i.adf_trigger_nm, i.run_group_id,
       i.run_param::text AS run_param, i.child_total_cnt, i.status,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT master_run_id IS NULL OR pipeline_nm IS NULL FROM p)
            THEN ('MASTER_PARAM_MISSING:' || (SELECT COALESCE(master_run_id, '') || '/' || COALESCE(pipeline_nm, '') FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM g) = 0
            THEN ('RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_JOB_TYPE:' || (SELECT run_group_nm FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT ids FROM nf) IS NOT NULL
            THEN ('TARGET_NOT_IN_GROUP:' || (SELECT ids FROM nf))::int
            WHEN (SELECT job_type_cd FROM g) = 'RAW_INCR'
             AND (SELECT cond_unit IS NULL OR cond_unit NOT IN ('DAY','MONTH','HOUR','MINUTE')
                         OR cond_interval IS NULL OR cond_interval !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' FROM p)
            THEN ('INCR_COND_VAR_INVALID:' || (SELECT COALESCE(cond_unit, '') || '/' || COALESCE(cond_interval, '') FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT ids FROM mm) IS NOT NULL
            THEN ('INCR_POLICY_MISMATCH:' || (SELECT cond_unit || '/' || cond_interval FROM p)
                  || ':' || (SELECT ids FROM mm))::int
            ELSE 1 END AS chk
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN ins i ON TRUE;

/* pl_cmn_run_check > Script "Scr_judge" (v8.3)
   전역 skip / BIZDAY 판정 결과 -> ctl_trigger_history 1행 (master_run_id 당 1회) + Master PENDING -> SKIPPED
   판정 순서 : GLOBAL_SKIP -> ETC (고객 DB 조회 실패) -> CALENDAR_MISSING -> NOT_BIZDAY -> 실행 (run_yn = Y, Master 는 PENDING 유지)
   BIZDAY 판정 대상 : p_bizday_n 이 있고 trigger_type 이 Manual 이 아닌 실행
   ETC : Master 는 SKIPPED 로 바꾸지 않음 (skip_reason_cd 제약). 이후 Fail 활동으로 파이프라인 실패 -> 마스터가 Master FAILED 처리
   같은 master_run_id 재호출 시 이력 중복 INSERT 안 함. ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'), '')                    AS master_run_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}'), ''), 'Manual')    AS trigger_nm,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_id}'), '')                       AS trigger_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_scheduled_time}'), '')::timestamptz      AS scheduled_dt,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_requester}'), '')                        AS requester_nm,
           '@{if(pipeline().globalParameters.gp_pipeline_run_skip, 'Y', 'N')}'::text                  AS gp_pipeline_run_skip,
           (NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_bizday_n}'), '') IS NOT NULL
            AND lower(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_type}')) <> 'manual')        AS bizday_yn,
           '@{variables('v_biz_err')}'::text                                               AS biz_err,
           '@{variables('v_biz_result')}'::text                                            AS biz_result,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                               AS created_by
),
/* v_biz_result = 당월 영업일 수 | RUN_YN | BASE_BIZ_DT | EXEC_DT */
b AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           NULLIF(btrim(split_part(p.biz_result, '|', 1)), '')::int AS biz_cnt,
           NULLIF(btrim(split_part(p.biz_result, '|', 2)), '')      AS biz_run_yn,
           NULLIF(btrim(split_part(p.biz_result, '|', 3)), '')      AS base_biz_dt,
           NULLIF(btrim(split_part(p.biz_result, '|', 4)), '')      AS exec_dt
      FROM p
),
d AS (
    SELECT b.*, m.run_group_id,
           CASE WHEN b.gp_pipeline_run_skip = 'Y'                                       THEN 'GLOBAL_SKIP'
                WHEN b.bizday_yn AND b.biz_err = 'Y'                              THEN 'ETC'
                WHEN b.bizday_yn AND COALESCE(b.biz_cnt, 0) = 0                   THEN 'CALENDAR_MISSING'
                WHEN b.bizday_yn AND COALESCE(b.biz_run_yn, 'N') <> 'Y'           THEN 'NOT_BIZDAY'
           END AS skip_reason_cd
      FROM b
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m ON m.master_run_id = b.master_run_id
),
h AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_trigger_history
          (adf_trigger_nm, adf_trigger_run_id, scheduled_dt, run_group_id, master_run_id,
           run_yn, skip_reason_cd, skip_msg, base_biz_dt, exec_dt, requester_nm)
    SELECT d.trigger_nm, d.trigger_run_id, d.scheduled_dt, d.run_group_id, d.master_run_id,
           CASE WHEN d.skip_reason_cd IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
           d.skip_reason_cd,
           CASE d.skip_reason_cd
                WHEN 'GLOBAL_SKIP'      THEN '전역 skip (g_skip_yn = true)'
                WHEN 'CALENDAR_MISSING' THEN '고객 영업일 데이터 없음 (MLDADM.TBCMB1001 당월 0건)'
                WHEN 'NOT_BIZDAY'       THEN '오늘은 지정한 영업일 (+offset) 이 아님'
                WHEN 'ETC'              THEN '고객 DB 영업일 조회 실패 (Lkp_biz_cnt / Lkp_bizday). ADF 모니터에서 RunId 확인'
           END,
           d.base_biz_dt, d.exec_dt, d.requester_nm
      FROM d
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM adfadm.ctl_trigger_history x WHERE x.master_run_id = d.master_run_id)
    RETURNING trigger_hist_id
),
u AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
       SET status         = CASE WHEN d.skip_reason_cd IN ('GLOBAL_SKIP','CALENDAR_MISSING','NOT_BIZDAY')
                                 THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE m.status END,
           skip_reason_cd = CASE WHEN d.skip_reason_cd IN ('GLOBAL_SKIP','CALENDAR_MISSING','NOT_BIZDAY')
                                 THEN d.skip_reason_cd END,
           end_dt         = CASE WHEN d.skip_reason_cd IN ('GLOBAL_SKIP','CALENDAR_MISSING','NOT_BIZDAY')
                                 THEN now() ELSE m.end_dt END,
           base_biz_dt    = COALESCE(d.base_biz_dt, m.base_biz_dt),
           updated_by     = d.created_by,
           updated_dt     = now()
      FROM d
     WHERE m.master_run_id = d.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'
    RETURNING m.master_run_id, m.status
)
SELECT d.skip_reason_cd,
       CASE WHEN d.skip_reason_cd IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS run_yn,
       d.base_biz_dt, d.exec_dt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS hist_ins_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE status = 'SKIPPED') AS master_skipped_cnt,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM d) = 0
            THEN ('MASTER_NOT_FOUND:' || (SELECT COALESCE(master_run_id, '') FROM p))::int
            ELSE 1 END AS chk
  FROM (SELECT 1) x
  LEFT JOIN d ON TRUE;

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_full > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script" (v8.3 FULL 전용, adf_script_v83_full_only.sql 기반)
   Master PENDING -> RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력(ctl_ingest_pipeline_run) PENDING 생성. Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 0건 반환
   대상 : Run Group(p_run_group_nm) 중 실행유형 FULL (RAW_FULL / META_FULL), p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능
   추출 위치 = COALESCE(NULLIF(cdc_tgt_*, ''), src_*), 파일명 / DBX 전달 = src_*
   landing_path 없으면 data_class 소문자/batch_date=YYYYMMDD/batch_hour=HH/pipeline_name=자식 파이프라인명
   file_nm_template 없으면 src_db.src_schema.src_table.YYYYMMDDHHMISS.parquet
   Script 재시도 = 0 (재시도 시 수집 이력 중복 생성). ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                  AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text               AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb    AS target_ids,
           '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text                     AS batch_str,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                             AS created_by
),
/* 1. 대상 + 추출 위치 */
t0 AS (
    SELECT e.run_group_id, e.run_rule_id, m.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(m.landing_path), '')     AS landing_path_in,
           NULLIF(trim(m.file_nm_template), '') AS file_nm_template_in
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target    e ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = e.target_id
     WHERE e.run_type_cd = 'FULL'
       AND (p.target_ids IS NULL
            OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.target_ids)::bigint))
),
/* 2. 자식 파이프라인명 / 경로 / 파일명 */
t AS (
    SELECT t0.*, x.pl_nm,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(t0.landing_path_in,
                        '{batch_date}',  left(p.batch_str, 8)),
                        '{batch_hour}',  substr(p.batch_str, 9, 2)),
                        '{pipeline_nm}', x.pl_nm)
                ELSE lower(t0.data_class)
                     || '/batch_date='    || left(p.batch_str, 8)
                     || '/batch_hour='    || substr(p.batch_str, 9, 2)
                     || '/pipeline_name=' || x.pl_nm
           END AS landing_path_out,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(t0.file_nm_template_in,
                        '{src_db}', t0.src_db_nm), '{schema}', t0.src_schema_nm), '{table}', t0.src_table_nm),
                        '{part}', ''), '{ts}', p.batch_str)
                ELSE t0.src_db_nm || '.' || t0.src_schema_nm || '.' || t0.src_table_nm
                     || '.' || p.batch_str || '.parquet'
           END AS file_name_out
      FROM t0 CROSS JOIN p
      /* 자식 파이프라인명 : pl_{data_class}_ingest_{src_type}_{추출 DB}  예) pl_raw_ingest_db2_MLCRP */
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 'pl_' || lower(t0.data_class) || '_ingest_' || lower(t0.src_type)
                                 || '_' || upper(t0.ext_db_nm) AS pl_nm) x
),
/* 3. Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING (+ 대상 건수). SKIPPED 등 다른 상태면 0건 -> 수집 이력 생성 안 함 */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
       SET status = 'RUNNING', start_dt = now(), updated_by = p.created_by, updated_dt = now(),
           child_total_cnt = (SELECT count(*) FROM t)
      FROM p
     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'
    RETURNING m.master_run_id
),
/* 4. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (Master 가 RUNNING 으로 전환된 경우만) */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, run_group_id, run_rule_id, target_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, run_type_cd,
           sink_type_cd, load_method_cd,
           src_type, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, data_class,
           extract_query, landing_path, file_name, sink_table_full_nm, status, created_by)
    SELECT p.master_run_id, t.run_group_id, t.run_rule_id, t.target_id, t.pl_nm, 'FULL',
           t.sink_type_cd,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' THEN 'FULL_DELETE_INSERT' END,
           t.src_type, t.src_db_nm, t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''), NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), t.data_class,
           /* 추출쿼리 : 템플릿 우선({WHERE} -> 1=1), 없으면 SELECT * (추출 위치 스키마) */
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t.src_query_template), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(t.src_query_template, '{WHERE}', '1=1')
                ELSE 'SELECT * FROM ' || t.ext_schema_nm || '.' || t.src_table_nm
                     || CASE upper(t.src_type) WHEN 'DB2'   THEN ' WITH UR'
                                               WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                                               ELSE '' END
           END,
           t.landing_path_out,
           t.file_name_out,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'TABLE' THEN concat_ws('.', t.sink_db_nm, t.sink_schema_nm, t.sink_table_nm) END,
           'PENDING',
           p.created_by
      FROM t CROSS JOIN p
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mst)
    RETURNING ingest_pipeline_id, master_run_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, extract_query, landing_path, file_name,
              sink_table_full_nm, target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm,
              cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, status
)
/* 5. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT ingest_pipeline_id,
       master_run_id,
       ingest_pipeline_nm,
       extract_query,
       COALESCE(landing_path, '')       AS landing_path,
       COALESCE(file_name, '')          AS file_name,
       COALESCE(sink_table_full_nm, '') AS sink_table_full_nm,
       target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
       sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, status
  FROM ins
 ORDER BY src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm;

/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (

activities.description: Master PENDING 등록 (INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH · PARTIAL_REFRESH / REQUEST). 실패하면 마스터도 실패 (Master 행 없음)

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_init > Script "Ins_master_run" (v8.3 개정 2, adf_script_v83_master_ins_init.sql 기반)
   Master PENDING 등록 (+ REQUEST 는 재수집 요청 확보). 진입 방식 정확히 하나
     A. INIT_LOAD  p_init_load_group / B. FULL_REFRESH · PARTIAL_REFRESH  p_run_group_nm (RAW_REFRESH 그룹) / C. REQUEST  p_request_yn = Y
   검증 실패 : 형변환 오류로 활동 실패 (Master 행 생성 안 됨). 같은 master_run_id 재실행 시 무시 (ON CONFLICT)
   변경 : Trigger명은 p_trigger_nm 우선, p_entry_run_id 를 entry_run_id 에 기록
   ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'::text                                     AS pipeline_nm,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_init_load_group}'), '')     AS init_load_group,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'), '')        AS run_group_nm,
           upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_request_yn}'), ''), 'N')) = 'Y' AS request_yn,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_scheduled_time}'), '')::timestamptz AS scheduled_dt,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb         AS target_ids,
           upper(NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_type_override}'), '')) AS run_type_override,
           '@{pipeline().TriggerType}'::text                                  AS trigger_type,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}'), ''), NULLIF('@{pipeline().TriggerName}', ''), 'Manual') AS trigger_nm,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_entry_run_id}'), '')        AS entry_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                  AS created_by
),
/* 진입 파라미터 개수 (정확히 1 이어야 함) */
e AS (
    SELECT p.*, (p.init_load_group IS NOT NULL)::int + (p.run_group_nm IS NOT NULL)::int + p.request_yn::int AS entry_cnt
      FROM p
),
/* A. INIT_LOAD : 대상 존재 여부만 검증 */
ga AS (
    SELECT e.* FROM e
     WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1 AND e.init_load_group IS NOT NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
                    WHERE m.init_load_group = e.init_load_group AND m.delete_yn = 'N')
),
/* B. FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH : 그룹(RAW_REFRESH) 경유 */
gb AS (
    SELECT e.*, g.run_group_id
      FROM e
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
        ON g.run_group_nm = e.run_group_nm AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y' AND g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_REFRESH'
     WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1
),
/* C. REQUEST : 확보할 PENDING 요청 */
gc AS (
    SELECT e.* FROM e WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1 AND e.request_yn
),
req AS (
    SELECT q.request_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
      JOIN gc ON TRUE
     WHERE q.status = 'PENDING' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
       AND (gc.target_ids IS NULL OR q.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(gc.target_ids)::bigint))
),
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, master_pipeline_nm, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, scheduled_dt,
           run_group_id, init_load_group, run_type_override_cd, run_param, entry_run_id, status, created_by)
    SELECT ga.master_run_id, ga.pipeline_nm, 'INIT_LOAD', ga.trigger_nm, ga.scheduled_dt,
           NULL, ga.init_load_group, NULL,
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('init_load_group', ga.init_load_group, 'target_ids', ga.target_ids)),
           ga.entry_run_id, 'PENDING', ga.created_by
      FROM ga
    UNION ALL
    SELECT gb.master_run_id, gb.pipeline_nm,
           CASE WHEN gb.trigger_type = 'Manual' THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE 'SCHEDULE' END,
           gb.trigger_nm, gb.scheduled_dt,
           gb.run_group_id, NULL,
           CASE WHEN gb.run_type_override = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH' THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH' END,
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('target_ids', gb.target_ids, 'run_type_override', gb.run_type_override)),
           gb.entry_run_id, 'PENDING', gb.created_by
      FROM gb
    UNION ALL
    SELECT gc.master_run_id, gc.pipeline_nm,
           CASE WHEN gc.trigger_type = 'Manual' THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE 'SCHEDULE' END,
           gc.trigger_nm, gc.scheduled_dt,
           NULL, NULL, 'REQUEST',
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('request', true, 'target_ids', gc.target_ids,
                                                'request_cnt', (SELECT count(*) FROM req))),
           gc.entry_run_id, 'PENDING', gc.created_by
      FROM gc
    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING master_run_id, trigger_type_cd, adf_trigger_nm, run_group_id, init_load_group,
              run_type_override_cd, run_param, status
),
/* C. 요청 확보 (Master 가 새로 등록된 경우만) */
claim AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status = 'RUNNING', master_run_id = i.master_run_id,
           updated_by = (SELECT created_by FROM p), updated_dt = now()
      FROM ins i
     WHERE i.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'
       AND q.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM req)
       AND q.status = 'PENDING'                /* 동시 실행 시 다른 실행이 먼저 확보한 요청 제외 */
    RETURNING q.request_id
)
SELECT i.master_run_id, i.trigger_type_cd, i.adf_trigger_nm, i.run_group_id, i.init_load_group,
       i.run_type_override_cd, i.run_param::text AS run_param, i.status,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM claim) AS request_cnt,
       /* 검증 실패 -> 형변환 오류로 활동 실패 (Master 행 생성 안 됨) */
       CASE WHEN (SELECT entry_cnt FROM e) <> 1
            THEN ('ENTRY_PARAM_INVALID:' ||
                  (SELECT COALESCE(init_load_group,'') || '/' || COALESCE(run_group_nm,'') || '/' || request_yn::text FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT init_load_group FROM p) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM ga) = 0
            THEN ('INIT_LOAD_GROUP_NOT_FOUND:' || (SELECT init_load_group FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT run_group_nm FROM p) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM gb) = 0
            THEN ('RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_REFRESH:' || (SELECT run_group_nm FROM p))::int
            ELSE 1 END AS chk
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN ins i ON TRUE;

text.value:
/* Prepare_src_lookup : 원천조회(PART) 가 필요한 Target 과 조회 쿼리. init.sql 의 파티션 값 결정 중 LOOKUP_ALL / LOOKUP_FROM 에 해당하는 대상만
     LOOKUP_ALL  : FULL_REFRESH + partition_clause 있음 (원천조회 전체)
     LOOKUP_FROM : 시작값(pv_start_val)만 지정 (끝값 · 목록 없음), INIT_LOAD 목록형 제외, REQUEST 제외
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건. 조회 위치 = 추출 위치 (cdc_tgt_* 우선)
   ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                           AS master_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_start_val')}'), '')      AS start_in,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_end_val')}'), '')        AS end_in,
           NULLIF('@{variables('pv_partition_val')}', '')::jsonb AS list_in
),
master_src AS (
    SELECT m.master_run_id, m.run_group_id, m.init_load_group,
           m.run_param -> 'target_ids' AS target_ids,
           (m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST') IS TRUE AS req_yn,
           CASE WHEN m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'  THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                WHEN m.run_type_override_cd IS NOT NULL THEN m.run_type_override_cd
                WHEN m.init_load_group      IS NOT NULL THEN 'INIT_LOAD'
                ELSE 'FULL_REFRESH' END AS run_type_cd
      FROM adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = m.master_run_id
     WHERE m.status = 'PENDING'
),
target_src AS (
    SELECT m.target_id, r.run_type_cd
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
        ON m.init_load_group = r.init_load_group AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR m.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.target_id, r.run_type_cd
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
        ON e.run_group_id = r.run_group_id AND e.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd <> 'INIT_LOAD' AND NOT r.req_yn
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
),
d AS (
    SELECT t.run_type_cd, m.target_id, m.src_type,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           m.src_table_nm, m.partition_clause,
           m.partition_clause ->> 'partition_column' AS part_col,
           m.partition_clause -> 'partition_val'     AS part_list
      FROM target_src t
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = t.target_id
)
SELECT d.target_id, d.ext_db_nm, d.ext_schema_nm, d.src_type, d.part_col,
       'SELECT DISTINCT ' || d.part_col || ' AS LOOKUP_VAL FROM ' || d.ext_schema_nm || '.' || d.src_table_nm
       || CASE upper(d.src_type) WHEN 'DB2' THEN ' WITH UR' WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)' ELSE '' END AS lookup_query
  FROM d CROSS JOIN p
 WHERE d.partition_clause IS NOT NULL AND d.part_col IS NOT NULL
   AND (   d.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
        OR (    NOT (d.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD' AND d.part_list IS NOT NULL)
            AND p.list_in IS NULL AND p.start_in IS NOT NULL AND p.end_in IS NULL))
 ORDER BY d.target_id;
