text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_init > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script" (v8.3 개정 6, adf_script_v83_init.sql)
   INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH / REQUEST 수집 이력 생성 (파티션 1개 = 1행). Master 가 PENDING 일 때만
   partition_clause : partition_column, partition_range (DAILY / MONTHLY / YEARLY), data_type, column_type (선택), format, partition_val (INIT_LOAD 목록, INVALID = 목록 외 + NULL)
   파티션 값 결정 (먼저 맞는 것) : 파티션 없음(INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH) 전체 1행 / REQUEST 요청 파티션 / FULL_REFRESH 원천조회 전체
     / INIT_LOAD 목록 / 시작 + 끝 기간 전개 / 변수 목록 / 시작값만 원천조회 중 시작값 이상
   실패 처리 : PARTITION_CLAUSE_INVALID:target_id / PARTITION_PARAM_MISSING:target_id (형변환 오류로 Script 실패 -> Master FAILED)
   Script 재시도 = 0. ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                           AS master_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_start_val')}'), '')      AS start_in,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_end_val')}'), '')        AS end_in,
           NULLIF('@{variables('pv_partition_val')}', '')::jsonb AS list_in,
           '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text             AS batch_ts,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                     AS created_by
),

/* 1. 이번 실행 Master (PENDING 일 때만) */
master_src AS (
    SELECT m.master_run_id, m.run_group_id, m.init_load_group,
           m.run_param -> 'target_ids' AS target_ids,
           (m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST') IS TRUE AS req_yn,
           CASE WHEN m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'  THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                WHEN m.run_type_override_cd IS NOT NULL THEN m.run_type_override_cd
                WHEN m.init_load_group      IS NOT NULL THEN 'INIT_LOAD'
                ELSE 'FULL_REFRESH' END AS run_type_cd
      FROM adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = m.master_run_id
     WHERE m.status = 'PENDING'
),

/* 2. 대상 Target */
target_src AS (
    /* INIT_LOAD : 초기수집 그룹 */
    SELECT NULL::int4 AS run_group_id, NULL::int8 AS run_rule_id, m.target_id
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
        ON m.init_load_group = r.init_load_group AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR m.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
    UNION ALL
    /* FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH : Run Group (RAW_REFRESH) */
    SELECT e.run_group_id, e.run_rule_id, e.target_id
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
        ON e.run_group_id = r.run_group_id AND e.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd <> 'INIT_LOAD' AND NOT r.req_yn
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
       /* 파티션 없는 Target 은 PARTIAL_REFRESH 대상이 아님 : 그룹 전체 실행이면 제외 (오류 없이), target_id 를 직접 지정하면 PARTITION_CLAUSE_INVALID */
       AND NOT (r.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH' AND r.target_ids IS NULL AND e.partition_clause IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    /* REQUEST : 이 실행이 확보한 요청의 Target (같은 Target 요청 여러 건은 1건) */
    SELECT DISTINCT NULL::int4, NULL::int8, q.target_id
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
        ON q.master_run_id = r.master_run_id AND q.status = 'RUNNING'
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = q.target_id AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
     WHERE r.req_yn
),

/* 3. partition_clause 분해 */
part_def AS (
    SELECT t.run_group_id, t.run_rule_id, r.master_run_id, r.run_type_cd, r.req_yn, m.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,      /* 추출 위치 */
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           m.partition_clause ->> 'partition_column'                         AS part_col,
           upper(m.partition_clause ->> 'partition_range')                   AS part_range,
           upper(m.partition_clause ->> 'data_type')                         AS part_type,
           upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.partition_clause ->> 'column_type'), ''),
                          m.partition_clause ->> 'data_type'))               AS col_type,
           m.partition_clause ->> 'format'                                   AS part_fmt,
           m.partition_clause -> 'partition_val'                             AS part_list
      FROM target_src t
      CROSS JOIN master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = t.target_id
),

/* 3-1. 설정 검증 + 파티션 값 결정 방식 + 기간 단위 */
part_mode AS (
    SELECT d.*, p.start_in, p.end_in, p.list_in,
           /* 범위 조건 여부 : 날짜 컬럼, 또는 문자 컬럼(YYYYMM 등 월 이하 형식) + YEARLY */
           (   d.col_type IN ('DATE','TIMESTAMP')
            OR (d.col_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                AND upper(d.part_fmt) LIKE '%MM%'))                          AS rng_yn,
           CASE d.part_range WHEN 'DAILY' THEN 'day' WHEN 'YEARLY' THEN 'year' ELSE 'month' END AS part_unit,
           CASE d.part_range WHEN 'DAILY' THEN interval '1 day'
                             WHEN 'YEARLY' THEN interval '1 year' ELSE interval '1 month' END AS part_step,
           CASE
             /* 파티션 없는 Target : 테이블 전체 1행 (INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 만) */
             WHEN d.partition_clause IS NULL AND NOT d.req_yn
                  AND d.run_type_cd IN ('INIT_LOAD','FULL_REFRESH')   THEN 'NONE'
             WHEN d.part_col IS NULL
               OR d.part_range NOT IN ('DAILY','MONTHLY','YEARLY')
               OR d.part_type  NOT IN ('STRING','NUMERIC','DATE','TIMESTAMP')
               OR d.col_type   NOT IN ('STRING','NUMERIC','DATE','TIMESTAMP')
               OR (d.part_type = 'STRING' AND NULLIF(trim(d.part_fmt), '') IS NULL)
               OR (d.col_type IN ('DATE','TIMESTAMP') AND d.part_type = 'NUMERIC')
                                                                     THEN ('PARTITION_CLAUSE_INVALID:' || d.target_id)::int::text
             WHEN d.req_yn                                           THEN 'REQUEST'
             WHEN d.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'                     THEN 'LOOKUP_ALL'
             WHEN d.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD' AND d.part_list IS NOT NULL THEN 'JSON_LIST'
             WHEN p.start_in IS NOT NULL AND p.end_in IS NOT NULL    THEN 'RANGE'
             WHEN p.list_in  IS NOT NULL                             THEN 'LIST'
             WHEN p.start_in IS NOT NULL                             THEN 'LOOKUP_FROM'
             ELSE ('PARTITION_PARAM_MISSING:' || d.target_id)::int::text
           END AS part_mode
      FROM part_def d CROSS JOIN p
),

/* 4. 파티션 값 목록 (part_kind : VAL 값 / INVALID 목록 외 / NULLV 원천 NULL / NONE 파티션 없음) */
partition_src AS (
    /* 파티션 없는 Target : 1행 */
    SELECT d.target_id, NULL::text AS part_val, 'NONE' AS part_kind
      FROM part_mode d
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'NONE'
    UNION ALL
    /* 재수집 요청의 파티션 (JSON null = NULL 파티션) */
    SELECT d.target_id, x, CASE WHEN x IS NULL THEN 'NULLV' ELSE 'VAL' END
      FROM part_mode d
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
        ON q.master_run_id = d.master_run_id AND q.target_id = d.target_id AND q.status = 'RUNNING'
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(q.partition_val) x
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'REQUEST'
    UNION ALL
    /* INIT_LOAD JSON 목록 */
    SELECT d.target_id, x, 'VAL'
      FROM part_mode d, jsonb_array_elements_text(d.part_list) x
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'JSON_LIST' AND x <> 'INVALID'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.target_id, 'INVALID', 'INVALID'
      FROM part_mode d
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'JSON_LIST' AND d.part_list @> '["INVALID"]'::jsonb
    UNION ALL
    /* 원천조회 값 (FULL_REFRESH 전체 / 시작값만 준 경우는 5 에서 시작값 이상만) */
    SELECT d.target_id, l.lookup_val, CASE WHEN l.lookup_val IS NULL THEN 'NULLV' ELSE 'VAL' END
      FROM part_mode d
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_src_lookup l
        ON l.master_run_id = d.master_run_id AND l.target_id = d.target_id AND l.lookup_type_cd = 'PART'
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_ALL'
        OR (d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_FROM' AND l.lookup_val IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    /* 시작 ~ 끝 기간 전개 (YEARLY 문자 값은 앞 4자리 연도로 해석 : '2025' / '202501' 모두 2025년) */
    SELECT d.target_id,
           CASE WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY' THEN to_char(g, 'YYYY')
                WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'    THEN to_char(g, d.part_fmt)
                WHEN d.part_type = 'TIMESTAMP' THEN to_char(g, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                ELSE                                to_char(g, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END,
           'VAL'
      FROM part_mode d,
           generate_series(CASE WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY' THEN to_date(left(d.start_in, 4), 'YYYY')
                                WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' THEN to_date(d.start_in, d.part_fmt)
                                ELSE d.start_in::date END::timestamp,
                           CASE WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY' THEN to_date(left(d.end_in, 4), 'YYYY')
                                WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' THEN to_date(d.end_in, d.part_fmt)
                                ELSE d.end_in::date END::timestamp,
                           d.part_step) g
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'RANGE' AND d.part_type <> 'NUMERIC'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.target_id, g::text, 'VAL'                  /* 숫자 : 1 씩 증가 [확인필요: 간격이 1이 아닌 경우] */
      FROM part_mode d, generate_series(d.start_in::bigint, d.end_in::bigint) g
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'RANGE' AND d.part_type = 'NUMERIC'
    UNION ALL
    /* 변수 목록 */
    SELECT d.target_id, x, 'VAL'
      FROM part_mode d, jsonb_array_elements_text(d.list_in) x
     WHERE d.part_mode = 'LIST'
),

/* 5. 범위 조건 대상 : 값 -> 기간 시작일. 같은 기간은 1건으로 합치고, 파티션 값은 기간 시작일을 다시 표기 (YEARLY 문자 = YYYY) */
partition_val AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.target_id, s.part_kind, k.from_dt,
           CASE WHEN k.from_dt IS NULL          THEN s.part_val
                WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY' THEN to_char(k.from_dt, 'YYYY')
                WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'     THEN to_char(k.from_dt, d.part_fmt)
                WHEN d.part_type = 'TIMESTAMP'  THEN to_char(k.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                ELSE                                 to_char(k.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS part_val
      FROM partition_src s
      JOIN part_mode d ON d.target_id = s.target_id
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT CASE WHEN d.rng_yn AND s.part_kind = 'VAL' THEN
                      date_trunc(d.part_unit,
                          CASE WHEN s.part_val ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN left(s.part_val, 10)::date
                               WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY' THEN to_date(left(s.part_val, 4), 'YYYY')
                               WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'                     THEN to_date(s.part_val, d.part_fmt)
                               ELSE s.part_val::date END)
                 END AS from_dt,
                 /* 시작값 (시작값만 준 경우의 필터용) */
                 CASE WHEN d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_FROM' AND d.rng_yn THEN
                      date_trunc(d.part_unit,
                          CASE WHEN d.start_in ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN left(d.start_in, 10)::date
                               WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING' AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY' THEN to_date(left(d.start_in, 4), 'YYYY')
                               WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'                     THEN to_date(d.start_in, d.part_fmt)
                               ELSE d.start_in::date END)
                 END AS start_dt
      ) k
     WHERE CASE WHEN d.part_mode <> 'LOOKUP_FROM' THEN TRUE
                WHEN d.rng_yn                THEN k.from_dt >= k.start_dt
                WHEN d.part_type = 'NUMERIC'      THEN s.part_val::numeric >= d.start_in::numeric
                ELSE                                   s.part_val >= d.start_in   /* 문자 비교 (YYYYMM 등 연도 시작 형식) */
           END
),

/* 5-1. 기간의 비교 문자열 (시작 이상, 다음 기간 시작 미만) */
partition_rng AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           CASE WHEN d.col_type = 'TIMESTAMP' THEN to_char(v.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00'
                WHEN d.col_type = 'STRING'    THEN to_char(v.from_dt, d.part_fmt)
                ELSE to_char(v.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END                               AS from_str,
           CASE WHEN d.col_type = 'TIMESTAMP' THEN to_char(v.from_dt + d.part_step, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00'
                WHEN d.col_type = 'STRING'    THEN to_char(v.from_dt + d.part_step, d.part_fmt)
                ELSE to_char(v.from_dt + d.part_step, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END                 AS to_str
      FROM partition_val v
      JOIN part_mode d ON d.target_id = v.target_id
),

/* 6. WHERE 조건 */
query_src AS (
    SELECT d.*, v.part_val, v.part_kind,
           count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.target_id) AS part_cnt,
           CASE
             /* 파티션 없음 : 조건 없음 */
             WHEN v.part_kind = 'NONE'  THEN NULL

             /* 원천 NULL 파티션 */
             WHEN v.part_kind = 'NULLV' THEN d.part_col || ' IS NULL'

             /* INVALID : 범위 조건 -> 목록 기간 밖 + NULL  (목록 값이 없으면 전체 1 = 1) */
             WHEN v.part_kind = 'INVALID' AND d.rng_yn THEN
                  COALESCE('(NOT ('
                           || (SELECT string_agg('(' || d.part_col || ' >= ''' || o.from_str || ''' AND '
                                                     || d.part_col || ' < '''  || o.to_str   || ''')', ' OR ' ORDER BY o.from_dt)
                                 FROM partition_rng o
                                WHERE o.target_id = d.target_id AND o.part_kind = 'VAL')
                           || ') OR ' || d.part_col || ' IS NULL)', '1 = 1')

             /* INVALID : 문자 · 숫자 컬럼 -> 목록 외 값 + NULL  (목록 값이 없으면 전체 1 = 1) */
             WHEN v.part_kind = 'INVALID' THEN
                  COALESCE('(' || d.part_col || ' NOT IN ('
                           || (SELECT string_agg(CASE WHEN d.col_type = 'NUMERIC' THEN o.part_val
                                                      ELSE '''' || o.part_val || '''' END, ', ' ORDER BY o.part_val)
                                 FROM partition_rng o
                                WHERE o.target_id = d.target_id AND o.part_kind = 'VAL')
                           || ') OR ' || d.part_col || ' IS NULL)', '1 = 1')

             /* 범위 조건 : 날짜 컬럼 / 문자 컬럼 + YEARLY */
             WHEN d.rng_yn THEN
                  d.part_col || ' >= ''' || v.from_str || ''' AND ' || d.part_col || ' < ''' || v.to_str || ''''

             /* 숫자 컬럼 */
             WHEN d.col_type = 'NUMERIC' THEN d.part_col || ' = ' || v.part_val

             /* 문자 컬럼 */
             ELSE d.part_col || ' = ''' || v.part_val || ''''
           END AS part_where,
           'pl_' || lower(d.data_class) || '_ingest_' || lower(d.src_type) || '_' || upper(d.ext_db_nm) AS ingest_pipeline_nm
      FROM part_mode d
      JOIN partition_rng v ON v.target_id = d.target_id
),

/* 7. Master PENDING -> RUNNING */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
       SET status = 'RUNNING', start_dt = now(), updated_by = p.created_by, updated_dt = now(),
           child_total_cnt = (SELECT count(*) FROM query_src)
      FROM p
     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'
    RETURNING m.master_run_id
),

/* 7-1. 수집 이력 (파티션 1개 = 1행, PENDING) */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, run_group_id, run_rule_id, target_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, run_type_cd,
           sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, range_column_nm, range_operator_cd, range_value,
           partition_value, partition_cnt,
           src_type, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, data_class,
           extract_query, landing_path, file_name, sink_table_full_nm, status, created_by)
    SELECT p.master_run_id, q.run_group_id, q.run_rule_id, q.target_id, q.ingest_pipeline_nm, q.run_type_cd,
           q.sink_type_cd,

           /* DBX 적재방식 */
           CASE WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'TABLE'         THEN NULL
                WHEN q.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'       THEN NULL
                WHEN q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH' THEN 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                ELSE 'FULL_DELETE_INSERT' END,

           /* DBX 범위 (PARTIAL_REFRESH 만 : 컬럼 IN [파티션값]) */
           CASE WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH' THEN q.part_col END,
           CASE WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH' THEN 'IN' END,
           CASE WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH' THEN jsonb_build_array(q.part_val) END,

           /* 파티션 값 · 수 (파티션 없음 = 둘 다 NULL) */
           CASE WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(q.part_val, '(NULL)') END,
           CASE WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE' THEN NULL ELSE q.part_cnt END,
           q.src_type, q.src_db_nm, q.src_schema_nm, q.src_table_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(q.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''), NULLIF(trim(q.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), q.data_class,

           /* 추출 쿼리 : 템플릿이 있으면 {WHERE} 치환 (파티션 없음 = 1 = 1), 없으면 SELECT * (추출 위치 스키마) */
           CASE
             WHEN NULLIF(trim(q.src_query_template), '') IS NOT NULL
                  THEN replace(q.src_query_template, '{WHERE}', COALESCE(q.part_where, '1 = 1'))
             WHEN upper(q.src_type) = 'DB2'
                  THEN 'SELECT * FROM ' || q.ext_schema_nm || '.' || q.src_table_nm
                       || COALESCE(' WHERE ' || q.part_where, '') || ' WITH UR'
             WHEN upper(q.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
                  THEN 'SELECT * FROM ' || q.ext_schema_nm || '.' || q.src_table_nm || ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                       || COALESCE(' WHERE ' || q.part_where, '')
             ELSE      'SELECT * FROM ' || q.ext_schema_nm || '.' || q.src_table_nm
                       || COALESCE(' WHERE ' || q.part_where, '')
           END,

           /* 랜딩 경로 : 기본 {data_class}/batch_date=YYYYMMDD/batch_hour=HH/pipeline_name={자식 파이프라인} */
           CASE WHEN q.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN NULLIF(trim(q.landing_path), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(q.landing_path,
                         '{batch_date}', left(p.batch_ts, 8)), '{batch_hour}', substr(p.batch_ts, 9, 2)),
                         '{pipeline_nm}', q.ingest_pipeline_nm)
                ELSE lower(q.data_class) || '/batch_date=' || left(p.batch_ts, 8)
                     || '/batch_hour=' || substr(p.batch_ts, 9, 2) || '/pipeline_name=' || q.ingest_pipeline_nm
           END,

           /* 파일명 : 기본 {src_db}.{src_schema}.{src_table}.{파티션값}.{ts}.parquet (NULL 파티션 = NULL, 파티션 없음은 파티션값 자리 없음) */
           CASE WHEN q.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN NULLIF(trim(q.file_nm_template), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(q.file_nm_template,
                         '{src_db}', q.src_db_nm), '{schema}', q.src_schema_nm), '{table}', q.src_table_nm),
                         '{part}', CASE WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE' THEN '' ELSE '.' || COALESCE(q.part_val, 'NULL') END),
                         '{ts}', p.batch_ts)
                ELSE q.src_db_nm || '.' || q.src_schema_nm || '.' || q.src_table_nm
                     || CASE WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE' THEN '' ELSE '.' || COALESCE(q.part_val, 'NULL') END
                     || '.' || p.batch_ts || '.parquet'
           END,

           CASE WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'TABLE' THEN concat_ws('.', q.sink_db_nm, q.sink_schema_nm, q.sink_table_nm) END,
           'PENDING', p.created_by
      FROM query_src q
      CROSS JOIN p
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mst)
    RETURNING ingest_pipeline_id, master_run_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, run_type_cd,
              extract_query, landing_path, file_name, sink_table_full_nm,
              target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
              sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, partition_value, partition_cnt, status
)

/* ForEach 입력 */
SELECT ingest_pipeline_id,
       master_run_id,
       ingest_pipeline_nm,
       extract_query,
       COALESCE(landing_path, '')       AS landing_path,
       COALESCE(file_name, '')          AS file_name,
       COALESCE(sink_table_full_nm, '') AS sink_table_full_nm,
       target_id, run_type_cd, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
       sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, partition_value, partition_cnt, status
  FROM ins
 ORDER BY target_id, partition_value;

activities.name: End_master_run
activities.description: Master 종료 (수집 이력 집계)

text.value:
/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

activities.name: Upd_init_wait_yn
activities.description: INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 전체 수집 성공 Target -> init_wait_yn = N

text.value:
/* Upd_init_wait_yn : INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 수집(전체 파일)이 모두 SUCCEEDED 인 Target 의 init_wait_yn 을 N 으로 변경
   대상 : 이 실행(master_run_id)의 수집 이력 중 run_type_cd IN (INIT_LOAD, FULL_REFRESH), SKIPPED 제외
          Target 별로 파티션 행 전체가 SUCCEEDED 일 때만 (하나라도 FAILED / RUNNING / PENDING 이면 유지 = Y)
          PARTIAL_REFRESH 는 전체 수집이 아니므로 제외. 이미 N 인 Target(FULL_REFRESH) 은 변경 없음
   ADF 수집(GEN2 저장) 기준. DBX 적재 결과와 무관. ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text  AS created_by
),
t AS (
    SELECT i.target_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = i.master_run_id
     WHERE i.run_type_cd IN ('INIT_LOAD', 'FULL_REFRESH')
       AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY i.target_id
    HAVING count(*) = count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED')
),
u AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
       SET init_wait_yn = 'N',
           updated_by   = p.created_by,
           updated_dt   = now()
      FROM t, p
     WHERE m.target_id = t.target_id
       AND m.init_wait_yn = 'Y'
       AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
    RETURNING m.target_id
)
SELECT count(*)                                        AS init_done_cnt,
       COALESCE(string_agg(target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY target_id), '') AS init_done_ids
  FROM u;

activities.name: Req_end
activities.description: 재수집 요청 종료 / 기준값 갱신 (REQUEST · FULL_REFRESH). 앞 단계가 모두 끝난 뒤 실행

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_init > Script "Req_end" (v8.3 개정, adf_script_v83_request_end.sql)
   End_master_run / Fail_master_run 등 앞 단계가 모두 끝난 뒤 실행. 해당 없는 실행에서는 대상 0건
   A. REQUEST 실행 : 이 실행이 확보한 RUNNING 요청 -> DONE (Target 의 수집 이력 모두 SUCCEEDED) / FAILED. DONE 이면 요청 파티션의 기준값을 요청을 만든 체크 값으로 갱신
   B. FULL_REFRESH 실행 : FULL_REFRESH 수집이 모두 성공한 Target -> FULL 권고(HOLD) DONE, 기준값 교체, 같은 Target 의 PENDING 부분 요청 CANCELED
   ADF 수집(GEN2 저장) 기준. ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text  AS created_by
),

/* A. REQUEST 실행 : 이 실행이 확보한 요청 */
req AS (
    SELECT q.*
      FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = q.master_run_id
     WHERE q.status = 'RUNNING'
),

/* Target 별 수집 결과 */
res AS (
    SELECT r.target_id,
           count(i.ingest_pipeline_id)                                       AS total_cnt,
           count(i.ingest_pipeline_id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succ_cnt
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT target_id FROM req) r
      CROSS JOIN p
      LEFT JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
             ON i.master_run_id = p.master_run_id AND i.target_id = r.target_id AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY r.target_id
),

/* 요청 상태 갱신 */
upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status     = CASE WHEN s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
           done_dt    = now(),
           error_log  = CASE WHEN s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt THEN NULL
                            WHEN s.total_cnt = 0 THEN '수집 이력 없음 (Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 확인)'
                            ELSE '수집 실패 ' || (s.total_cnt - s.succ_cnt) || '건 / ' || s.total_cnt || '건' END,
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now()
      FROM res s, p
     WHERE q.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM req) AND q.target_id = s.target_id
    RETURNING q.request_id, q.target_id, q.status
),

/* 기준값 대상 : DONE 된 정합성 요청의 파티션 + 그 체크의 값 (Target, 파티션별 최신 요청 1건) */
base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.target_id, x.pv)
           q.target_id, x.pv, q.check_run_id, v.row_cnt, v.max_val, v.hash_val,
           (v.row_cnt IS NOT NULL) AS exists_yn
      FROM req q
      JOIN res s ON s.target_id = q.target_id AND s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(e, '(NULL)') AS pv
                            FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q.partition_val) e) x
      LEFT JOIN adfadm.ctl_partition_check c
             ON c.master_run_id = q.check_run_id AND c.target_id = q.target_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.row_cnt, r.max_val, r.hash_val
                           FROM jsonb_to_recordset(c.result_json) AS r(part_key text, row_cnt bigint, max_val text, hash_val text)
                          WHERE COALESCE(r.part_key, '(NULL)') = x.pv) v ON TRUE
     WHERE q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY' AND q.check_run_id IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY q.target_id, x.pv, q.requested_dt DESC, q.request_id DESC
),

/* B. FULL_REFRESH 실행 : 이 실행에서 FULL_REFRESH 수집이 모두 성공한 Target */
full_tgt AS (
    SELECT i.target_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = i.master_run_id
     WHERE i.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH' AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY i.target_id
    HAVING count(*) = count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED')
),

/* 그 Target 의 FULL 권고 중 가장 최근 1건 (기준값 교체용 체크) */
full_hold AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.target_id) q.target_id, q.check_run_id, c.result_json, c.check_to_key
      FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
      JOIN full_tgt f ON f.target_id = q.target_id
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_partition_check c ON c.master_run_id = q.check_run_id AND c.target_id = q.target_id
     WHERE q.status = 'HOLD' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH' AND q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY'
     ORDER BY q.target_id, q.requested_dt DESC, q.request_id DESC
),

/* FULL 권고 DONE, 부분 재수집 대기 요청 CANCELED */
full_upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status        = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END,
           master_run_id = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN p.master_run_id ELSE q.master_run_id END,
           done_dt       = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN now() ELSE q.done_dt END,
           error_log     = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN NULL
                                ELSE 'FULL_REFRESH 로 대체 (' || p.master_run_id || ')' END,
           updated_by    = p.created_by,
           updated_dt    = now()
      FROM p
     WHERE q.target_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM full_tgt)
       AND q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY'
       AND (   (q.status = 'HOLD' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH')
            OR (q.status = 'PENDING' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'))
    RETURNING q.request_id, q.status
),

/* FULL 기준값 : 체크 값 전체 */
full_cur AS (
    SELECT h.target_id, h.check_run_id, h.check_to_key,
           COALESCE(x.part_key, '(NULL)') AS pv, x.row_cnt, x.max_val, x.hash_val
      FROM full_hold h
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(h.result_json) AS x(part_key text, row_cnt bigint, max_val text, hash_val text)
),

/* 기준값 반영 (A + B, Target 이 겹치지 않음) */
base_up AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_partition_state
          (target_id, partition_value, row_cnt, max_val, hash_val, check_run_id, collect_run_id, created_by)
    SELECT b.target_id, b.pv, b.row_cnt, b.max_val, b.hash_val, b.check_run_id, p.master_run_id, p.created_by
      FROM base b CROSS JOIN p
     WHERE b.exists_yn
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.target_id, f.pv, f.row_cnt, f.max_val, f.hash_val, f.check_run_id, p.master_run_id, p.created_by
      FROM full_cur f CROSS JOIN p
    ON CONFLICT (target_id, partition_value) DO UPDATE
       SET row_cnt = EXCLUDED.row_cnt, max_val = EXCLUDED.max_val, hash_val = EXCLUDED.hash_val,
           check_run_id = EXCLUDED.check_run_id, collect_run_id = EXCLUDED.collect_run_id,
           updated_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, updated_dt = now()
    RETURNING target_id
),
base_del AS (
    DELETE FROM adfadm.ctl_partition_state s
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base b
                    WHERE NOT b.exists_yn AND s.target_id = b.target_id AND s.partition_value = b.pv)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM full_hold h
                    WHERE h.target_id = s.target_id
                      AND (   h.check_to_key IS NULL OR s.partition_value = '(NULL)'
                           OR s.partition_value COLLATE "C" < h.check_to_key COLLATE "C")
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM full_cur f
                                       WHERE f.target_id = s.target_id AND f.pv = s.partition_value))
    RETURNING s.target_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd)                              AS request_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE status = 'DONE')        AS done_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE status = 'FAILED')      AS failed_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM full_upd WHERE status = 'DONE')   AS full_done_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM full_upd WHERE status = 'CANCELED') AS full_canceled_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM base_up)                          AS state_upsert_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM base_del)                         AS state_delete_cnt;
